# Milano Backup Tool

**Author:** Quanta Computer Inc.<br/>
**Platforms:** ODM

A service utility for Siemens ST55 and ST60. It allows you to create a backup
copy of phone data and clear the user area when restoring the device.

## Versions

- **4.11** — [milano-backup-4.11.zip](https://git.siepatch.dev/siepatch/soft/media/branch/main/catalog/service/milano-backup/files/milano-backup-4.11.zip) (2004-02-02)<br/>Includes configurations for COM1–COM6<br/>Windows 32-bit · 6.31 MiB
